text:
Leah (CS): heads up — Greenfield Systems renewal hit procurement gate: they need a wet-signed amendment + wire instructions on invoice. onboarding paused until payment/exec signoff :confused:
Omar (AE): do they have a PO? we should send an invoice stub + pdf SOW for their PO request
Leah (CS): procurement asked for vendor code and approver name. said scanned notarized wet-sign acceptable but must include notary stamp
Priya (Finance): we can add wire instructions. which billing entity should appear? Greenfield mentioned US vs EU entities
Omar (AE): use Greenfield Inc (US) for this renewal, they may split later
Daria (Legal): send amendment text. for 6mo term we need to remove auto-renew and add exec signatory block. scanned notarized sign is ok if signatory authority is clear
Leah (CS): uploaded amendment: https://docs.redwood/greenfield/amend-1930 and SOW PDF: https://files.redwood/sow/greenfield-sow-1930.pdf
Leah (CS): @invoice-bot create manual invoice stub with wire details and NET30, include line: "Onboarding - 1 session" and show service_start date
invoice-bot: created INV-2026-1022 for Greenfield Inc. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/inv/INV-2026-1022
Priya (Finance): updated INV-2026-1022: payment_terms=Net30, remittance="Bank of Redwood, ACH:12345678, SWIFT:RWDXUS33", billing_entity="Greenfield Inc", service_start=2026-05-01
Omar (AE): emailed procurement (Claire Nguyen) with invoice+SOW+amendment and asked if scanned notarized sign will be attached. requested PO# by EOD
invoice-bot: payment status INV-2026-1022 = PENDING
Leah (CS): procurement replied: vendor code GF-2023, approver Claire.Nguyen@greenfield.com, will attach notarized scan and submit PO GF-PO-5542 tomorrow AM
Daria (Legal): posting signature block for scanned notarized sign: "Signed for Greenfield Inc by: Name, Title, Date, Notary Name & Seal (scanned)". confirm signatory name once PO attached
Priya (Finance): note: once wire posts, please include PO# in remittance reference for reconciliation
Omar (AE): got PO# GF-PO-5542 and scanned notarized amendment attached to their ticket, uploading to case management now
Leah (CS): next steps: 1) Priya to monitor bank for wire 2) Daria to confirm signatory authority 3) Omar to confirm PO mapping in billing system 4) Leah to tentatively hold onboarding week of May 3rd until PAID
Priya (Finance): will update when wire received and mark invoice PAID. ping me for any remittance mismatches
Leah (CS): thanks all. will keep this thread open until PAID then send final kickoff invite. :pray:
